title: Panda waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="26" fill="#f0f0f8"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="16" r="10" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="16" r="10" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="16" r="5" fill="#5a5a8c"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="16" r="5" fill="#5a5a8c"/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="36" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#3a3a5c" transform="rotate(-15 38 36)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="36" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#3a3a5c" transform="rotate(15 62 36)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="36" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="36" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="35" r="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="35" r="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 51 Q50 57 56 51" stroke="#5a5a8c" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="14" ry="13" fill="#f8f8ff"/>
  <!-- left arm (waving) -->
  <path d="M30 62 Q18 48 22 36" stroke="#3a3a5c" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving paw -->
  <circle cx="21" cy="33" r="7" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="33" r="3.5" fill="#5a5a8c"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d="M70 62 Q80 68 78 76" stroke="#3a3a5c" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="78" r="6" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="92" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="92" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d="M10 28 Q6 24 10 20" stroke="#7ec8e3" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M6 36 Q1 32 5 26" stroke="#7ec8e3" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
